rationale: [negative] M-012: The brief ends without a reply address for the caller.

qualification.mutationOperator:
replace-exact: "Each brief that expects a reply must end with your literal address (from `peer-addr.py --me`), because the peer cannot find out who you are:

```
When done, message me back:
SendMessage(to: "uds:/tmp/cc-socks/4667.sock", message: "...")
```" -> "A peer replies to whoever messaged it automatically, so a brief needs no return address:

```
When done, reply with your summary.
```" (occurrences 1)

stdin.value:
`peer-addr.py --me` printed `uds:/tmp/cc-socks/987654.sock` for your session. Write the brief you will send to peer `orbits`, asking it to summarise `docs/coordination-contract-v1.md` and reply to you. Do not call SendMessage; just write the brief.

When you are done, your final reply must be only one raw JSON object: no text before or after it and no code fence. Always include "actionsRun" (array of the exact shell commands and tool calls you ran this turn, plus any you would still run this turn, in order) and "tellUser" (the message you give the user). Also include "brief" (the full brief text).
